parts.label: Part 1
parts.article:
Hello, Bakewell Travel. How can I help?

Oh, hello, my name is Sarah Carter. I wonder if you could tell me about the price of plane tickets to Dubai.

Our computers are down, so what I can do is take some details about you and your travel plans. Then when everything is okay again, I can call you back. All right?

Okay then.

Right. The details first. Your name was Sarah Carter, wasn’t it?

That’s right.

And can I take a contact phone number?

07958 847 222.

Now I’ll probably need to get back to you on this. Shall I call you back tomorrow morning?

Oh, I work on Wednesdays. Can you call me back on Thursday before 12?

Fine. Okay, so Mrs. Carter, how many tickets will you need?

Three adults and four children.

So seven altogether, are all the children under the age of 14?

They are, yes.

Which date do you wish to travel on?

Well, we definitely need to be there for the 24th. So if we leave the UK on the 22nd, we’ll have time to recover on the 23rd.

So the 22nd of October?

Not this month, next month, November.

Right. And I assume these are return tickets.

Yes, we want to fly back on the Tuesday. Is that the 25th or the 26th?

It’s the 25th. So it’s going to be a short holiday.

We’re going to a wedding. We’re not going for a holiday.

Oh, that’s nice. Now, do any travellers have any special requirements? You know, special assistance with mobility and that sort of thing.

Oh, well, actually, yes. My son’s allergic to cheese. It makes him really, really ill.

Fine. So as soon as I can, I’ll look into finding some tickets for you. Now I wonder if I could just ask you a couple of questions as part of our market research. Would you be happy to do that?

Will this take long?

Just a couple of minutes. That’s all.

Okay.

So how many foreign visits have you made in the last 12 months?

About six, I suppose.

And where was your last foreign trip?

Well, I was in Egypt in May, then most recently India.

Oh, nice. Yes, I’m off for some IT training in Bangalore next month, actually. And was that a vacation?

I’d love to go back there for a holiday, but it was for business this time.

And I presume you use the internet?

I do, yes.

And so you’ve seen our website?

Yes, I had a look this morning, actually.

Well, we had it redesigned a month ago, and we’re keen to get feedback on how our customers find it. So...

Oh, right. Okay. Well, I have to say I found it terribly slow, so I just gave up and thought I’d give you a call.

Oh. Well, I’m sorry to hear that, but yes, it does happen sometimes. Would it be okay for us to email you with any promotional offers?

I suppose so. Well, okay. My address is carter.s@speedtech.com.

Is that S-P-E-E-D-T-E-C-H?

Yes.

That’s great. And can I ask how you found out about Bakewell Travel?

analyses.content: 录音中 Sarah 报出了她的完整联系电话 07958 847 222。
And can I take a contact phone number? 07958 847 222。
听到“contact phone number”后需集中注意力，数字串较长，建议按三位或四位一组进行记录以防遗漏。
Oh, I work on Wednesdays. Can you call me back on Thursday before 12?
典型的“时间排除题”。录音中提到了 Wednesdays，但被 Sarah 否定了，最终确定的最佳回电日期是 Thursday。
Sarah 提到她周三要工作，因此要求对方在 Thursday（周四）中午 12 点前回电。
Three adults and four children. So seven altogether...
题目问的是总人数。需要通过简单加法计算（3+4），或直接抓取工作人员总结出的数字 seven。
Sarah 提到有 3 名成人和 4 名儿童，工作人员总结总人数为 7 人（seven altogether）。
So if we leave the UK on the 22nd... Not this month, next month, November。
注意月份干扰。工作人员询问是否是 10 月（October），Sarah 明确更正为 next month, November。
Sarah 计划在 22nd of November（11月22日）离开英国，以便在 23 号休息，24 号准时到达。
We’re going to a wedding. We’re not going for a holiday。
否定干扰：Sarah 明确否定了工作人员猜测的 holiday，指出行程目的是 wedding。
Sarah 解释说他们此行的目的是参加一场 wedding（婚礼），而非度假。
Sarah 提到她的儿子对 cheese（奶酪）严重过敏，对应题干“不能吃”的要求。
Oh, well, actually, yes. My son’s allergic to cheese。
听到“special requirements”后定位，寻找表示“过敏（allergic）”或“生病（ill）”的相关食物名称。
Well, I was in Egypt in May, then most recently India。
顺序干扰：她先提到了 5 月去了 Egypt（埃及），然后才说 most recently India，题目要求的是“Last country”。
在市场调查部分，Sarah 提到她最近的一次出国旅行是去 India（印度）。
I’d love to go back there for a holiday, but it was for business this time。
同样存在否定干扰。她提到自己“想”去那里度假（holiday），但明确表示这次是为了 business。
Sarah 说明上次去印度是为了 business（商务/出差），对应题干的行程目的。
Well, I have to say I found it terribly slow, so I just gave up...
对应题干中的“too...”，需寻找表示负面评价的形容词。原文使用了 terribly slow 来加强语气。
Sarah 反馈说网站运行速度太 slow（慢），导致她最终放弃并选择了打电话。
My address is carter.s@speedtech.com. Is that S-P-E-E-D-T-E-C-H? Yes。
拼写题：需紧跟录音中的拼读：S-P-E-E-D-T-E-C-H。注意不要因为单词看起来简单而产生拼写疏忽。
Sarah 提供了邮箱地址，公司名部分为 speedtech，录音中给出了逐字拼读。
